subject: Algorithm
source_sentence: If no matches are found, the algorithm extracts the NEs from the tweets through 's system, and applies the following two heuristics: i) if a NE is of type dbo:Organisation or dbo:Person, it considers such NE as the source; ii) it searches in the abstract of the DBpedia7 page linked to that NE if the words "news", "newspaper" or "magazine" appear (if found, such entity is considered as the source).
